question: A regular polygon has 30 sides. Find the measure of one interior angle.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any regular polygon, the exterior angle is directly related to the number of sides by a simple ratio.

⇒ Exterior Angle = 360° ÷ n

⇒ Exterior Angle = 360° ÷ 30 = 12°

Since the interior and exterior angles always form a straight line (180°):

⇒ Interior Angle = 180° − 12° = 168°

**∴ The correct answer is 168°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides of the regular polygon (n) = 30

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of a regular polygon = (n − 2) × 180°

Measure of one interior angle = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of interior angles = (30 − 2) × 180°

⇒ Sum of interior angles = 28 × 180° = 5040°

⇒ Measure of each interior angle = 5040° ÷ 30

⇒ Measure of each interior angle = 168°

**∴ The correct answer is 168°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Exterior Angles

For any convex polygon, regardless of the number of sides, the sum of all its exterior angles is always exactly 360°.

Number of Diagonals

The total number of diagonals in a polygon with n sides can be quickly calculated using the formula: n(n − 3) ÷ 2.

Regular vs Irregular Polygons

A regular polygon is both equilateral (all sides equal) and equiangular (all angles equal). An irregular polygon lacks one or both of these properties.
